events.text: A great fungal bloom carpets the caverns of Hisia; spore-bread and lamp-moss for all.
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Kisu bars the shaft to Qasr Dishabu, and the tithe-collectors of Lunupenui are turned back at the lamps of Wotohto.
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Poledan bars the shaft to Al-yashu, and the tithe-collectors of Ejney are turned back at the lamps of Pahodobongu.
Al-dakdul squeezes the shaft-tolls of Yami; the miners of Kunokibo mutter beneath the stone.
Hurkota squeezes the shaft-tolls of Bobanubape; the miners of Lunupenui mutter beneath the stone.
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Ngethani bars the shaft to Pakodan, and the tithe-collectors of Lunupenui are turned back at the lamps of Pahodobongu.
SKY BLOCKADE: the floating hosts of Rowaga close the air-lanes above Rarpeng, starving Rarpeng of the high trade.
SKY BLOCKADE: the floating hosts of Ngoha close the air-lanes above Ayteschach, starving Hurkota of the high trade.
Itutun raises its port toll at Esurez; the harbour-masters of Unik protest.
SEA EMBARGO: Yenanekiwe seals the deep channels, and no hull leaves the port of Ittesjib for Hurkota.
SEA EMBARGO: Sebu seals the deep channels, and no hull leaves the port of Lerthani for Hurkota.
Where the Netleh left its silt, the fields of Wohtlan now yield double; Sohohmih remembers the flood with mixed feelings.
The banners of Negapura are raised over Nogehalago as victorious cohorts march in, ending Chelkachnak's dominion over the district.
The walls of Saltlan crumble under heavy assault! Cohorts of Negapura breach the defenses of Chelkachnak's capital, scattering the garrison and sacking the palace.
After a bitter siege, the ramparts of Popusa give way! Vanguard forces of Negapura storm the royal seat of Chelkachnak, casting down imperial banners and plundering the state vaults.
The banners of Rarpeng are raised over Pakkay as victorious cohorts march in, ending Ngawpura's dominion over the district.
Garrisons of Rarpeng storm the ramparts of Woskok, driving out the defenders of Ngawpura and hoisting their triumphant colors.
Envoys from Sohohpopih and Wotohto exchange solemn vows of mutual defense, binding their courts in a grand alliance.
Envoys from Sohohmih and Wotohto exchange solemn vows of mutual defense, binding their courts in a grand alliance.
With swords drawn and ancient pacts invoked, Commune of Unik marches against Republic of Ümomibordu. The Border War of Ümomibordu begins.
Old border feuds boil over into open bloodshed: Commercial Union of Lunupenui launches a determined invasion into Theocracy of Yezobeso, igniting the Lunupenui–Yezobeso War.
With swords drawn and ancient pacts invoked, Syndicate of Ütomokent marches against Republic of Ümomibordu. The Great Ütomokent War begins.
Envoys convene upon neutral ground to ratify a solemn treaty, concluding the War of the Hisia Crown after 5 years. With frontiers redrawn, Hurkota & Ejney dictate terms to the vanquished.
Humbled, Republic of Hisia bends the knee and becomes a vassal of Hurkota, paying yearly tribute.
Humbled, Theocracy of Sirizima bends the knee and becomes a vassal of Hurkota, paying yearly tribute.
ENFORCED REGIME CHANGE: Victorious armies from Hurkota mandate total political reorganization in Hisia! Overthrowing the vanquished elite, they inaugurate the Syndicate of Hisia.
Envoys convene upon neutral ground to ratify a solemn treaty, concluding the War of the Lidupalida Crown after 2 years. With frontiers redrawn, Negapura & Sohohmih dictate terms to the vanquished.
ENFORCED REGIME CHANGE: Following decisive defeat in war, Negapura imposes constitutional terms upon Lidupalida! The former rulers are ousted, and the Military Junta of Lidupalida is inaugurated.
Ötema II of Ütomokent takes up the cause of the fortunes of the dynasty.
In the royal halls of Ütomokent, Ötema the Fearless Akönobibagün breathes their last, succumbing to a wasting sickness. Ötema ascends the ancestral throne amid solemn acclamation.
Owa II of Nudiko takes up the cause of wealth.
The death of Ola Lasaka (old age) leaves Nudiko without an acknowledged heir. In the ensuing succession crisis, House Lonuna seizes the high throne amidst palace turmoil.

AGRARIAN REVOLT: Crushed by feudal tithes and noble exploitation, the laborers of Nichuacan rise in open insurrection! Renouncing the lords of Kemnis, they establish the People's Republic of Nichuacan with Kawwiw leading the commune.
Kawwiw is acclaimed ruler of People's Republic of Nichuacan.

Outraged by treason, the crown of Stratocracy of Kemnis mobilizes imperial cohorts to crush the upstart insurrection in People's Republic of Nichuacan. The Border War of Nichuacan begins in fire and iron.

POPULAR REVOLUTION: Spurred by cries for liberty and bread, popular assemblies across Wehtle overthrow the old order! Monarchy is dismantled, and the revolutionary convention inaugurates the People's Republic of Wehtle.

POPULAR REVOLUTION: Crowds fill the avenues of Daki as a mass uprising topples the throne of Iron Dominion of Daki! The ancient autocracy is abolished, and Taja proclaims the sovereign Confederation of Daki!
COUP D'ETAT: Mutinous conspirators led by Qunanu strike at midnight in Fufabad! The revolutionary council seizes control, overthrowing the sovereign and proclaiming the Polytechnic League of Fufabad!
COUP D'ETAT: Armed regiments loyal to Hohihlo storm the government palace in Sohkeh! The faction seizes control, establishing the Theocracy of Sohkeh.
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Woteli are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Shohada!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Covert saboteurs from Fimokuda detonate powder stores in Chelkachnak, gutting frontline regiments!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Fimokuda are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Chelkachnak!
QUEST COMPLETED: Rescue of the Stranded River Barges at Rurmospura! Hirtet brings the fleet and its crews to deep water, and grateful merchants pay 100 Gold!
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Wemoho pave the Okhidobalik-Ezachbalik Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Okhidobalik and Ezachbalik (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Rarpeng pave the Rarpeng-Woskok Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Rarpeng and Woskok (+trade, +stability).
The Putayu–Suayu Maglev is rebuilt: Ejney takes over the line and relays the track, and trains run again.
The Yehloh–Nehtohyihni Maglev of Mohmistlan reaches Netohtlo: a new station opens to cheering crowds (+trade).

DIVINE PROXY WAR: The war between Ütomokent and Ümomibordu escalates into a celestial proxy duel! Pestilax the Rot-Father rallies the hosts of Ütomokent, while Ignis the Hearth Caldera unleashes sacred omens to shield Ümomibordu.
RUINOUS GIFT: Tzannik the Architect of Fate mutates the weave of fate in Dumi! Arcane mutations grant uncanny clairvoyance and secret gold, at the cost of civil panic (+30 gold, -6 stability).
PATRON MIRACLE: Solarius the Dawn-Bringer bestows a radiant dawn upon Lunupenui! Granaries overflow with miraculous golden grain, soothing civil unrest (+18 stability, +20 gold).
NATURE BLESSING: Gorath the Stone Peak heaves rich subterranean veins to the surface of Chelkachnak! Granite ramparts harden against all siegecraft (+25 gold, +15 stability).
Chanting somber litanies, the Coven of the Crimson Chalice parades through Esurez, rebuking high prelates and demanding immediate spiritual penance from the lords of Unik.
Acclaimed by the roar of the crowds, Nobigi turns against tyrannical masters in Ngape, emerging as a legendary folk champion for the downtrodden.
Known as the People's Blade, Iletüb defies the magistrates of Wemoho from the woodland hollows of Okhidobalik, shielding humble villagers from unjust confiscations.

Taja of Daki comes to the throne bent on the safety of the realm.
Qunanu of Fufabad comes to the throne bent on knowledge.
Tata of Hisia swears vengeance on Hurkota for the sack of Kaqar.
Hohihlo of Sohkeh comes to the throne bent on the fortunes of the dynasty.
Yke II of Bitere lets go of the aim for the spread of the faith.
Josumi conquered Floor 1 (Floor of the Whispering Sands) using assault (score 20 vs DC 8). Defeated Kaelen. Promoted to F-Rank!
Wuha survived descent to Layer 1 (Edge of the Abyss), enduring 13 strain damage: Light dizziness and loss of balance upon ascent. Whistle tier: red. Salvaged ancient relic: Sun Stone Shard!
Bonfires burn in Dugotugondar for the finding of the true cross; Dumi sings in an ancient liturgical tongue.
Shadow-puppet plays run all night in Hugito, retelling the epics of heroes and gods.
The Wayfarers of Reformed Covenant of Dar Kubi is founded in Pahodobongu; it takes to the roads, preaching and living on alms.
The Wandering Circle of Supu finds patrons in Totabhumi.
A cold upwelling chills the domes of Sebu; kelp farms wither and the reefs bleach.
The tiny Theocracy of Sirizima seeks shelter and is peacefully absorbed into Hurkota.
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Larodu bars the shaft to Zazimu, and the tithe-collectors of Lunupenui are turned back at the lamps of Larodu.
SKY BLOCKADE: the floating hosts of Rowaga close the air-lanes above Rarpeng, starving Rarpeng of the high trade.
SKY BLOCKADE: the floating hosts of Ngoha close the air-lanes above Ayteschach, starving Hurkota of the high trade.
SEA EMBARGO: Lewebaland seals the deep channels, and no hull leaves the port of Chinnil for Kemnis.
Winds that bend palms to the ground hammer the coast of Sohohmih in high summer; Pitloche is flooded to the market square.
OUTBREAK: the Bloody Purging appears in Pitloche: drunk from fouled wells and river water; it follows the rivers downstream and haunts the ports.
OUTBREAK: the Ezachbalik Purging appears in Ezachbalik: drunk from fouled wells and river water; it follows the rivers downstream and haunts the ports.
The War of the Hisia Crown is known as the Liberation among the Yondog, and as the Betrayal among the Hatadazata.
The War of the Lidupalida Crown is known as the Reclamation among the Baweheranga, and as the Usurpation among the Gapohogopa.
The Ümomibordu–Agümibisüd Maglev is cut: soldiers of Unik tear up the maglev track and the trains stop.
Festival of Colours: People of Hidibokot wake the year with song and fresh green boughs at Hibisa.
Rarpeng overruns the defensive holdfasts of Hoggey, annexing the town and its fertile environs from Ngawpura.
The banners of Unik are raised over Oqash as victorious cohorts march in, ending Ümomibordu's dominion over the district.
Following fierce fighting along the fortifications, Agümibisüd surrenders to Ütomokent; its magistrates swear fealty as Ümomibordu's banner is hauled down.
The walls of Ngawpura crumble under heavy assault! Cohorts of Rarpeng breach the defenses of Ngawpura's capital, scattering the garrison and sacking the palace.
Banners trampled and throne abandoned, Free Union of Chelkachnak ceases to exist as a sovereign power. Nelwinneha Chakhanhiw flees the ashes of their former dominion.
Rice Blessing: Granaries of Ngoha are opened at Ngoha; the whole town eats until dusk.
The Negapura–Chelkachnak War reaches its conclusion after 1 year of bloodshed: Negapura triumph decisively, forcing a humiliating treaty upon their foes.
Beaten back from stubborn ramparts, the invasion stalls. The War of the Ngawpura Crown concludes after 3 years as Rarpeng & Negapura successfully preserve their independence.
Yablama of Rarpeng wins the glory sought in the War of the Ngawpura Crown.
The Border War of Ümomibordu reaches its conclusion after 1 year of bloodshed: Unik triumph decisively, forcing a humiliating treaty upon their foes.
Humbled, Republic of Ümomibordu bends the knee and becomes a vassal of Unik, paying yearly tribute.
A victor's peace is forged: after 1 year of campaign in the Lunupenui–Yezobeso War, Lunupenui prevail, annexing contested borderlands.
Humbled, Theocracy of Yezobeso bends the knee and becomes a vassal of Lunupenui, paying yearly tribute.
Yisewemo of Lunupenui wins the glory sought in the Lunupenui–Yezobeso War.
Yth II of Doqihimo takes up the cause of the fortunes of the dynasty.
The reign of Yth the Tall Yvuf in Doqihimo concludes with their death (old age). Yth takes up the royal mantle, vowing to defend the realm.
Bina of Shohada takes up the cause of the spread of the faith.
Mourning envelops Shohada: Yogi the Cruel Lasubohotidu dies of fever. The royal scepter passes to Bina, an underage youth of 3 years, under the stewardship of high chancellors.

THE GREAT REFORMATION: In Ile-dobe, Ledi nails ninety-five theses condemning clerical indulgence! Proclaiming the Reformed Covenant of Ile-dobe, reformers split from ancient dogma. Riots break out as iconoclasts smash old idols.
Prosperity shines upon Rowaga: master architects and poets flock to Hugito as coffers overflow and harvests reach record yields.
Blight strikes the grain harvests of Fimokuda; hunger stalks village and city alike as bread prices soar.
Fuda opens the royal granaries of Fimokuda; bread is carted to every village and the people bless the crown.
COUP D'ETAT: Armed regiments loyal to Fuba storm the government palace in Nudiko! The faction seizes control, establishing the Empire of Nudiko.
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Pahanibhumi are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Biskay!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Agitators dispatched by Yezobeso stir mutiny among garrison troops in Ngawpura!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Yezobeso are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Ngawpura!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Hisia are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Daki!
QUEST COMPLETED: Saving the Terraces of Bokoka Before the Rains! Gomeru sees the terraces hold and the first seedlings stand green, winning Immortal Renown and a steadier realm!
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Lunupenui pave the Pahunula-Bobanubape Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Pahunula and Bobanubape (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Mohmistlan pave the Netohtlo-Howihcpan Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Netohtlo and Howihcpan (+trade, +stability).
The Üzad–Elankhot Railway of Unik reaches Unüdisusotos: a new station opens to cheering crowds (+trade).
The Wotohto–Netohweh Maglev opens: another maglev of Lunupenui runs from Wotohto to Netohweh, with stations in both towns.
NATURE BLESSING: Gorath the Stone Peak heaves rich subterranean veins to the surface of Lewebaland! Granite ramparts harden against all siegecraft (+25 gold, +15 stability).
Folk songs celebrate Ofa, a righteous rebel who raids the fortified convoys of Negapura to feed starving families in the districts around Dude.

Whispers of a millenarian doomsday cult known as the Sisters of the Pale Moon sweep through Nigiwa! Zealous converts burn their coin, abandon their workshops, and gather in dark cellars to await the celestial end.
Unrest of the year: bread riots in Doqihimo; bread riots in Fido (Ride).

Following fierce fighting along the fortifications, Nogehalago surrenders to Kemnis; its magistrates swear fealty as Saltlan's banner is hauled down.

Giti of Hidibokot turns from the old cause toward the fortunes of the dynasty.

The Great Pahodobongu War is known as the Unprovoked War among the Bopodokanale, and as the Rightful War among the Ubkiw.
The Hundred Days War of Ezus is known as the Reclamation in Ütomokent, and as the Usurpation in Ezus.
Lunupenui sends an expedition through the Singing Door.
Day of Rain Offerings: People of Sebu wake the year with song and fresh green boughs at Letoha.
Banners trampled and throne abandoned, Artificer Directorate of Poduludesh ceases to exist as a sovereign power. Dihita Shubi flees the ashes of their former dominion.
Envoys convene upon neutral ground to ratify a solemn treaty, concluding the Border War of Poduludesh after 2 years. With frontiers redrawn, Biskay & Negapura dictate terms to the vanquished.
Night of Shadow Plays: Scholars and singers of Hubu compete in Tinga; the best verse is carried through the streets.
Ballgame of the Hero Twins: Warriors of Itutun parade and wrestle in the squares of Itutun to honour the old victories.
Feast of the Pilgrim Caravan: Granaries of Al-dakdul are opened at Al-dakdul; the whole town eats until dusk.
Envoys from Sohohpopih and Pewenajaw exchange solemn vows of mutual defense, binding their courts in a grand alliance.
Citing border encroachments and bitter territorial grievances, High Realm of Mohmistlan mobilizes its hosts against Kingdom of Pahodobongu. Banners unfurl for the Conquest of Pahodobongu.

THE GREAT REFORMATION: In Bonga, Roba nails ninety-five theses condemning clerical indulgence! Proclaiming the Reformed Covenant of Bonga, reformers split from ancient dogma. Riots break out as iconoclasts smash old idols.

AGRARIAN REVOLT: Crushed by feudal tithes and noble exploitation, the laborers of Nogehalago rise in open insurrection! Renouncing the lords of Kemnis, they establish the Popular Commonwealth of Totaladesa with Ngeha leading the commune.
Ngeha is acclaimed ruler of Popular Commonwealth of Totaladesa.
Vowing to eradicate rebellion, Grand Marshalate of Kemnis marches swiftly upon Popular Commonwealth of Totaladesa. The drums of the Conquest of Totaladesa echo across the provinces.
A bloody conspiracy in the capital: General Duhese marches veterans into the council hall, deposing Zawukuko and proclaiming military rule over Yezobeso.
Sigadumi of Yezobeso takes up the cause of the spread of the faith.
INTERREGNUM ABOLITION: Following the death of the sovereign without heirs, the estates of Yezobeso reject dynastic succession! A citizen senate convenes, proclaiming the Commune of Yezobeso.
Duhese of Yezobeso takes up the cause of the spread of the faith.
Duhese takes the throne of Yezobeso.
Dizosu (Master Artisan) unveils a breathtaking marble colossus in the central plaza in Debre Biwiso.

POPULAR REVOLUTION: Crowds fill the avenues of Negapura as a mass uprising topples the throne of Stratocracy of Negapura! The ancient autocracy is abolished, and Segmos proclaims the sovereign Democratic Union of Negapura!
COUP D'ETAT: A sudden palace putsch overthrows the established order in Wehtle! Mehsi seizes control amidst martial decrees, proclaiming the Council of Ingenuity of Wehtle!

POPULAR REVOLUTION: Spurred by cries for liberty and bread, popular assemblies across Suholenagara overthrow the old order! Monarchy is dismantled, and the revolutionary convention inaugurates the People's Republic of Suholenagara.
COVERT INTRIGUE: Counterfeit letters planted by Howewitepec rupture trust between Biskay and their ally Negapura!
QUEST COMPLETED: Delve into the Primeval Foundry in Yofi! Yomopihi returns triumphant from Yofi, having uncovered forgotten secrets and winning Immortal Renown!
QUEST UNDERTAKEN: Haka embarks upon the Raid on the Shadow Keep in Udunüz! Haka gathers scouts and infiltrates the frontier redoubts near Udunüz to pinpoint the captive's cell.

NATURE BLESSING: Undina of the Silver Basin purifies the sacred rivers of Totaladesa! Abundant fish and unhindered river trade enrich the townships (+30 gold, +12 stability).

After 30 months, the River Purging is gone; Negapura counts the empty houses.

REPUBLICAN REVOLT: Declaring citizen liberty inviolable, the populace of Oqash casts out imperial governors! Renouncing allegiance to Unik, Obekhokh proclaims the sovereign Democratic Union of Aröqanyurt.

After a bitter siege, the ramparts of Suse give way! Vanguard forces of Unik storm the royal seat of Sobewai, casting down imperial banners and plundering the state vaults.
An ancient sovereign power falls to dust: Commune of Echordu is extinguished. Royal archives smolder, and Okhina Eqüdibudün flees into obscurity.
The Hundred Days War of Echordu reaches its conclusion after 2 years of bloodshed: Unik triumph decisively, forcing a humiliating treaty upon their foes.
Banners trampled and throne abandoned, Sacred Order of Sobewai ceases to exist as a sovereign power. Teweba Popebileto'a flees the ashes of their former dominion.
Envoys convene upon neutral ground to ratify a solemn treaty, concluding the Unik–Sobewai War after less than a year. With frontiers redrawn, Unik dictate terms to the vanquished.
Feast of the Pilgrim Caravan: Granaries of Kaqar are opened at Kaqar; the whole town eats until dusk.
First Fruit Offerings: Granaries of Wemoho are opened at Wemoho; the whole town eats until dusk.
Night of Offerings: Families in Lihseshuacan Beyond set out lamps and food for their dead at Yehloh.
After a bitter siege, the ramparts of Pawu give way! Vanguard forces of Kunokibo storm the royal seat of Pawu, casting down imperial banners and plundering the state vaults.

Envoys from Hurkota and Hurkota Beyond exchange solemn vows of mutual defense, binding their courts in a grand alliance.
Citing border encroachments and bitter territorial grievances, Theocracy of Lunupenui mobilizes its hosts against Trade Federation of Dumi. Banners unfurl for the Great Lunupenui War.
Beaten back from stubborn ramparts, the invasion stalls. The Invasion of Kunokibo concludes after 5 years as Kunokibo successfully preserve their independence.
ENFORCED REGIME CHANGE: Victorious armies from Kunokibo mandate total political reorganization in Fimokuda! Overthrowing the vanquished elite, they inaugurate the Commercial Union of Fimokuda.

White banners flutter over the war camps. The Hundred Days War of Newekuta ends in mutual exhaustion after less than a year; borders return to former lines.

The annalists of Chewnis will remember the years 201 to 220 as "The Troubles of Chewnis".
The annalists of Tahnis will remember the years 202 to 220 as "The Golden Years of Tahnis".
The annalists of Al-yaty will remember the years 204 to 220 as "The Age of Usurpers in Al-yaty".
The annalists of Yth will remember the years 209 to 220 as "The Quiet Years of Yth".
The Totaladesa Campaign is known as the Holy Defence among the Gapohogopa, and as the Heretics' War among the Baweheranga.
The Wehtle–Sohnihche Maglev is cut: soldiers of Sohohmih tear up the maglev track and the trains stop.
The banners of Sohohmih are raised over Mohco as victorious cohorts march in, ending Sohohpopih's dominion over the district.
The Wotohto–Netohweh Maglev is cut: soldiers of Sohohmih tear up the maglev track and the trains stop.
The banners of Sohohpopih are raised over Metelalibela as victorious cohorts march in, ending Dumi's dominion over the district.
The banners of Sohohmih are raised over Yehse as victorious cohorts march in, ending Sohohpopih's dominion over the district.
Garrisons of Sohohmih storm the ramparts of Yehse, driving out the defenders of Sohohmih and hoisting their triumphant colors.
The Pihtle–Sohnihche Maglev is cut: soldiers of Sohohmih tear up the maglev track and the trains stop.
The banners of Sohohmih are raised over Sohnihche as victorious cohorts march in, ending Sohohpopih's dominion over the district.
Following fierce fighting along the fortifications, Yehtlo surrenders to Sohohmih; its magistrates swear fealty as Sohohpopih's banner is hauled down.
Sohohmih overruns the defensive holdfasts of Mohpihlicheh, annexing the town and its fertile environs from Sohohpopih.
Following fierce fighting along the fortifications, Huboningulu surrenders to Ejney; its magistrates swear fealty as Pahodobongu's banner is hauled down.
Festival of the Ancestors: Families in Fimokuda set out lamps and food for their dead at Fimokuda.
Dasa of Bidotiti turns from the old cause toward knowledge.
A perilous interregnum grips Bidotiti following the heirless death of Datu (old age). Retainers of House Palibonihuda storm the assembly and usurp the crown.
Shibuju of Kaqar takes up the cause of glory.
Dynastic extinction strikes Kaqar: Bafina dies heirless (old age). Amid whispers of poison and sword-drawn councils, House Nuqa claims the vacant crown.
Sehoki (Philosopher) publishes a groundbreaking philosophical treatise that inspires court reforms in Pitloche.
Kokema (Master Artificer) designs a rapid-firing ballista mechanism adopted by frontier garrisons in Fupemotu.
COUP D'ETAT: Armed regiments loyal to Lege storm the government palace in Negapura! The faction seizes control, establishing the Stratocracy of Negapura.

POPULAR REVOLUTION: Rising against tyranny and privilege, the populace of Daki storms the seat of government! With the former regime swept aside, Naha proclaims the foundation of the Republic of Daki!

POPULAR REVOLUTION: Rising against tyranny and privilege, the populace of Biskay storms the seat of government! With the former regime swept aside, Dihita proclaims the foundation of the Free Union of Biskay!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Agitators dispatched by Itutun stir mutiny among garrison troops in Kunokibo!
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Fewapenui pave the Wamahu-Paneperoa Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Wamahu and Paneperoa (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Mohmistlan pave the Popihtepec-Netohtlo Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Popihtepec and Netohtlo (+trade, +stability).
RUINOUS GIFT: Pestilax the Rot-Father touches the hosts of Ejney with blissful pestilence! Rotting flesh feels no pain, turning armies into unyielding revenants (+12% army power, +10 resilience).
ELDRITCH MANIFESTATION: Shubbog the Brood Mother spawns thousands of chittering dark young in the sacred groves of Kunokibo, swarming forward under black skies (+20% army power, -6 stability).
Walking unharmed across contested frontiers, Peteni arrives at Tlimoltlan with tidings of sacred peace. War cohorts drop their spears in reverence, touched by the prophet's words.
Unrest of the year: tax riots in Wodenu (Sohkeh).

A warm current sweeps past Josunok'in; shoals of silver fish and drifting pearls enrich Josunok'in.

monsters.name: The Deep Lake Wyrm
monsters.lore: An elusive plesiosaur-like lake cryptid spoken of in local campfire folklore, surfacing only when mists veil the waters.

monsters.name: Tusk-Lord of the Briars
monsters.lore: A massive armored tusker leading wild forest herds, tearing up farmland and trampling watchtowers.
monsters.trophy: Calydonian Boar Great Tusks & Armored Hide

monsters.name: The Storm Roc of the Badlands
monsters.lore: The roc of sailors' and caravaneers' tall tales, a bird vast enough to carry off an elephant; its wingbeats raise dust storms over the canyons.

monsters.name: Ignis the Red Calamity
monsters.lore: An ancient volcanic dragon sleeping atop mountains of melted gold, reducing invading armies to calcined bones.

monsters.name: White Tiger of the Ridge
monsters.lore: A colossal pale tiger of snow-clad ridges, silent as autumn wind, that warbands speak of only in whispers.

monsters.name: Lion of the Golden Dawn
monsters.lore: An immortal noble lion with a mane of radiant sunlight, whose majestic roar dispels dark enchantments.
monsters.trophy: Solar Lion Mane of Golden Light

monsters.name: Winterfang
monsters.lore: A frost-breathing great wyrm dwelling in glacial crevasses, freezing rivers solid with a single exhalation.

monsters.name: The Emerald Qilin
monsters.lore: A gentle horned dragon-beast cloaked in scales of jade, appearing only during the reigns of benevolent and enlightened rulers.

monsters.name: Ponaturi Night-Raiders
monsters.lore: Hostile sea goblins of the old hero tales who sleep beneath the waves by day and come ashore at night; sunlight destroys them.

monsters.name: The Ahuizotl of the Lake
monsters.lore: A water dog with a hand at the end of its tail that drags fishermen beneath the lake.

monsters.name: The Steppe Cyclops
monsters.lore: A one-eyed giant of the steppe epics, slain only by a hero clever enough to blind him.

monsters.name: The White Cadejo
monsters.lore: Spectral dogs of the night roads: the white one guards travellers, the black one leads them astray.

monsters.lore: Wild magic given a body, it wanders the land the surge burned.

species.name: Human
species.desc: Versatile and ambitious mortals who build sprawling empires across every continent.

species.name: Elf
species.desc: Graceful, long-lived beings attuned to primal magic, ancient forests, and stellar harmonies.

species.name: Dwarf
species.desc: Stout, resolute masters of masonry, deep mining, and forged steel who carve citadels into living stone.

species.name: Orc
species.desc: Fierce, muscular warriors governed by martial honor, blood covenants, and relentless resilience.

species.name: Troll
species.desc: Massive, regenerative brutes of mossy crags and deep wetlands possessing primeval strength.

species.name: Beastman
species.desc: Prideful therianthropic folk bearing lupine, feline, or minotaur aspects, hunters of boundless wildlands.

species.name: Halfling
species.desc: Clever, jovial, and nimble folk who build peaceful pastoral burrows or intricate clockwork workshops.

species.name: Giant
species.desc: Colossal beings of primeval stone, frost, and storm, keeping ancient memory of the world's dawn.

species.name: Goblin
species.desc: Prolific, cunning, and resourceful tinkerers who thrive in shadowy crevices, mines, and scrap cities.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.desc: Scale-bound noble warriors descended from dragons, wielding elemental breath and stubborn pride.

species.name: Merfolk
species.desc: Aquatic humanoids of the coral reefs and sunlit shallows, rulers of the pelagic depths.

species.name: Starborn
species.desc: Luminous beings born of falling stars and astral conduits, radiating transcendent grace.

species.name: Ratfolk
species.desc: Cunning subterranean rodentkin and warpstone tinkerers who breed rapidly in foul under-empires.

species.name: Lizardfolk
species.desc: Cold-blooded ancient guardians of the geomantic web who defend temple-cities under primal mandates.

species.name: Tomb Revenant
species.desc: Ancient slumbering skeletal pharaohs and living-metal monarchs commanding eternal legions.

species.name: Ogor
species.desc: Massive nomadic brute warriors driven by eternal hunger and gut-magic across mountains and steppes.

species.name: Void Elf
species.desc: Ancient psychic wanderers of cosmic webways with spirit stones preserving souls against the void.

species.name: Warp Fiend
species.desc: Horned warp-manifestations born of cosmic fractures and excess emotion hungry for slaughter.

species.name: Chitin Swarm
species.desc: Synaptic bio-constructs with chittering carapaces driven by a devouring hive-mind.

diseases.name: plague
diseases.desc: carried by fleas on rats and on the cloth of traders; it rides the roads and the ships

diseases.name: flux
diseases.desc: drunk from fouled wells and river water; it follows the rivers downstream and haunts the ports

diseases.name: pox
diseases.desc: passed hand to hand and breath to breath; those who live through it never take it again

diseases.name: marsh fever
symptoms: a yellow cast to the skin
diseases.desc: brought by biting flies in hot wetlands; it lingers where the water stands still

diseases.name: consumption
symptoms: a cough that brings up blood
diseases.desc: a slow sickness of crowded cities that eats the lungs over years

diseases.name: blight
diseases.desc: a rot of the crops, not of people: it kills by hunger

diseases.name: miasma
symptoms: a lead taste in the mouth
diseases.desc: the bad air of the factory towns, thickest where the chimneys stand closest

diseases.name: radiation sickness
diseases.desc: not caught but soaked up: it clings to fallout grounds and the dust of old craters

diseases.name: engineered strain
diseases.desc: something made in a vat or a lab that got out; it spreads fast and burns out fast

diseases.name: hollowing
symptoms: a cold that no fire warms
diseases.desc: a sickness of the spirit; the old wives say it comes from broken wards

events.text: Vowing to eradicate rebellion, Commercial Union of Ki-nya marches swiftly upon Protectorate of Nziland. The drums of the Great Ki-nya War echo across the provinces.
Master Artificer Tuishaegie of Diikot achieves worldwide acclaim with their magnum opus: "The Clockwork Chronometer".

POPULAR REVOLUTION: Rising against tyranny and privilege, the populace of Ki-nya storms the seat of government! With the former regime swept aside, Myinbunfa proclaims the foundation of the Free Commonwealth of Ki-nya!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Assassins from Mimape strike in the dead of night, slaying Kalyichje' in the court of Rongame!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Mimape are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Rongame!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Agitators dispatched by Jitun stir mutiny among garrison troops in Memefọba!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Gubhumi are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Chichtitlan!
QUEST COMPLETED: Raising the Broken Causeway of Tlippan! Chichtay sees the first loaded porters cross, and the council of Tlippan grants Immortal Renown and a steadier realm!
QUEST UNDERTAKEN: Becori embarks upon the Expedition to the Ancient Vault in Naputela! Becori deciphers faded parchment maps and astrological charts pointing toward the vaults of Naputela.
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Chichtitlan pave the Chichtitlan-Rotimotu Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Chichtitlan and Rotimotu (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Choykey pave the Noytepec-Timpan Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Noytepec and Timpan (+trade, +stability).

ELDRITCH MANIFESTATION: Nyxal the Void Dreamer projects psychic void-whispers into the foes of Diqoqia! Invaders flee in weeping delirium, haunted by visions of tentacled cosmic voids (+18% army power, -7 stability).
ELDRITCH MANIFESTATION: Shubbog the Brood Mother spawns thousands of chittering dark young in the sacred groves of Wovowe, swarming forward under black skies (+20% army power, -6 stability).

ELDRITCH MANIFESTATION: Cthulor the Abyssal Slumberer stirs in the ocean abyss beneath Mopyoktliy! Barnacle-encrusted cyclopean monoliths surface, loaded with pre-human treasure (+35 gold, -5 stability).
Defying cruel overseers, Sefo leads an uprising in the arena quarter of Tabowomo. Freed combatants rally behind the champion's banner, sworn to protect the weak.
Unrest of the year: bread riots in Ledadium.

Shrivvotve of Groyva secures the line, with Broyvi grown to take the crown.
Myinbunfa of Ki-nya comes to the throne bent on the safety of the realm.
Tiusheamaa of Soadesh lets go of the aim for a lasting legacy.
Jeytecha conquered Floor 1 (Floor of the Sunken Crypt) using magic (score 22 vs DC 8). Defeated Astra. Promoted to F-Rank!
Soishaepii survived descent to Layer 1 (Edge of the Abyss), enduring 9 strain damage: Light dizziness and loss of balance upon ascent. Whistle tier: red. Salvaged ancient relic: Sun Stone Shard!
Dhows from far coasts anchor at Myango; Nziland trades ivory and gold for porcelain and silk.
Stepwells are dug across Rousheu; Diopura survives the dry season with water to spare.
Nyunwa imposes manorial fiefs upon its vassal Nyampiland.
Zhaynayn raises its port toll at Lefdadmore; the harbour-masters of Cidium protest.
Rains swell the Wuhorohuwaru until it takes the bridges of Ngemonui; whole villages float away downstream.
Vines and barley grow thick on the old ash of the God Cone; Cavsedgacfes prospers where it once mourned.
Flames engulf the towers of Xyttox! Soldiers of Rongame force the inner courtyards of Haghkeloth's capital; the royal garrison breaks, and the seat of power falls.
Flames engulf the towers of Myango! Soldiers of Ki-nya force the inner courtyards of Nziland's capital; the royal garrison breaks, and the seat of power falls.
Banners trampled and throne abandoned, Protectorate of Nziland ceases to exist as a sovereign power. Nwumlanfa Mpunsonwa flees the ashes of their former dominion.
After a bitter siege, the ramparts of Hitkez give way! Vanguard forces of Yepe storm the royal seat of Hitkez, casting down imperial banners and plundering the state vaults.
Following fierce fighting along the fortifications, Duishaa surrenders to Rousheu; its magistrates swear fealty as Mopyoktliy's banner is hauled down.
The Great Ki-nya War reaches its conclusion after less than a year of bloodshed: Ki-nya triumph decisively, forcing a humiliating treaty upon their foes.
Families of Tiashoi and Kyxxoz marry across the border; the Shiumaasia and Zyk'ukzygh folk grow closer.
Envoys from Sakeninadu and Yepe exchange solemn vows of mutual defense, binding their courts in a grand alliance.

Ambition stirs in the courts of Empire of Kofa, which openly claims dominion over Workers' Federation of Geyrim. The realm braces as the Geyrim Succession War erupts. Pledging mutual defense, the levies of Diashudesh rally to Geyrim's side.
Liushaaroe (Grand Champion) bestows glorious sporting renown upon the host realm in the international games in Piapatna.
Repaniwi (Grand Champion) bestows glorious sporting renown upon the host realm in the international games in Te Rikiva.
COUP D'ETAT: Mutinous conspirators led by Et'ikzoza strike at midnight in Kiqyeh! The revolutionary council seizes control, overthrowing the sovereign and proclaiming the Stratocracy of Kiqyeh!
COUP D'ETAT: A sudden palace putsch overthrows the established order in Kolstan! Zhizllash seizes control amidst martial decrees, proclaiming the Iron Dominion of Kolstan!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Memefọba are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Wovowe!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Covert saboteurs from Qighxyth detonate powder stores in Sakeninadu, gutting frontline regiments!
QUEST COMPLETED: Search for the Lost Relic in Linco! Milufafi unlocks the sealed adamantine vault, unearthing the sacred relic Sun-forged Diadem of Fipa to global acclaim!
QUEST UNDERTAKEN: Luahoushii embarks upon the Recovering the Palm-Leaf Library of Ki-nya! Luahoushii hears of a lost palm-leaf library kept by a vanished school near Ki-nya.
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Yepe pave the Hitkez-Mopyoktliy Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Hitkez and Mopyoktliy (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Chichtitlan pave the Chichtitlan-Limonui Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Chichtitlan and Limonui (+trade, +stability).
The Raqari–Gosicium Maglev of Cidium reaches Cidium: a new station opens to cheering crowds (+trade).
The Dowdal–Weythani Maglev of Gubhumi reaches Yosayu: a new station opens to cheering crowds (+trade).
PATRON MIRACLE: Solarius the Dawn-Bringer bestows a radiant dawn upon Nyunwa! Granaries overflow with miraculous golden grain, soothing civil unrest (+18 stability, +20 gold).
RUINOUS GIFT: Pestilax the Rot-Father touches the hosts of Rousheu with blissful pestilence! Rotting flesh feels no pain, turning armies into unyielding revenants (+12% army power, +10 resilience).
NATURE BLESSING: Ignis the Hearth Caldera stokes the caldera hearths of Kolstan! Master smiths forge shimmering obsidian weaponry bathed in magma (+16% army power, +15 gold).
Fear grips the outskirts of Ile-yufu as villagers uncover shrines belonging to the Brotherhood of Ash and Stone. The coven's clandestine activities provoke fervent investigations by the crown.
Defying cruel overseers, Ifa leads an uprising in the arena quarter of Bomutetane. Freed combatants rally behind the champion's banner, sworn to protect the weak.
Fanatics of the Sisters of the Pale Moon march through the night in Ruigarh, clad in mourning shrouds and wailing omens of doom. The sudden panic empties markets and roils civic stability.

Roars of Brimstone the Dragon-King echo across the wilderness, striking fear into travelers and local herders.
The banners of Tiasheu are raised over Nevo as victorious cohorts march in, ending Korunahu's dominion over the district.
Festival of Colours: People of Riavarta wake the year with song and fresh green boughs at Doabad.
Following fierce fighting along the fortifications, Zhikshozh surrenders to Tiasheu; its magistrates swear fealty as Sopgesh's banner is hauled down.
After a bitter siege, the ramparts of Wiybob give way! Vanguard forces of Nyunwa storm the royal seat of Mabajaw, casting down imperial banners and plundering the state vaults.
Flames engulf the towers of Latvozh! Soldiers of Diashudesh force the inner courtyards of Hastag's capital; the royal garrison breaks, and the seat of power falls.

The final citadels fall, and the crown of People's Republic of Mabajaw is broken forever. With treasuries emptied and borders dissolved, Yowbekma' Mubbupjeb flees into bitter exile as the realm fades into legend.
The Hundred Days War of Mabajaw reaches its conclusion after 2 years of bloodshed: Nyunwa triumph decisively, forcing a humiliating treaty upon their foes.
Ballgame of the Hero Twins: Warriors of Jemlil parade and wrestle in the squares of Jemlil to honour the old victories.
Festival of the Ancestors: Families in Sage set out lamps and food for their dead at Mesopebe.
Families of Tiashoi and Kiqyeh marry across the border; the Shiumaasia and Zyk'ukzygh folk grow closer.

Citing border encroachments and bitter territorial grievances, Merchant League of Nyunwa mobilizes its hosts against Sacred Order of Ngimyumzomlu. Banners unfurl for the Great Nyunwa War. Pledging mutual defense, the levies of Rousheu rally to Ngimyumzomlu's side.
Ambition stirs in the courts of Cybernetic Union of Puwwib, which openly claims dominion over Principality of Yewebọba. The realm braces as the War of Puwwib erupts.
Raeshiu of Choykey takes up the cause of wealth.
Solemn rites echo through Choykey following the death of Liushaaroe Lionheart  (a fall from a horse). Raeshiu is crowned sovereign before the assembled court.
Reymagnuga of Gubhumi comes to the throne bent on a lasting legacy.
In the royal halls of Gubhumi, Bokhir the Hammer Pukrelteh breathes their last, succumbing to old age. Reymagnuga ascends the ancestral throne amid solemn acclamation.

Insurrection flares in Tabowomo! Declaring their liberties inviolable, the populace casts off the yoke of Tiasheu and rallies beneath the banner of Sepe, establishing the Artificer Directorate of Tabowomo.
Sepe is acclaimed ruler of Artificer Directorate of Tabowomo.
Seeking to restore imperial order by force, Merchant League of Tiasheu dispatches punitive legions to subdue Artificer Directorate of Tabowomo. The bitter Tiasheu–Tabowomo War is underway.
COUP D'ETAT: Mutinous conspirators led by Mamhoknek strike at midnight in Tlatkit! The revolutionary council seizes control, overthrowing the sovereign and proclaiming the Principality of Tlatkit!
COUP D'ETAT: Mutinous conspirators led by Tlektoy strike at midnight in Choykey! The revolutionary council seizes control, overthrowing the sovereign and proclaiming the Grand Duchy of Choykey!

POPULAR REVOLUTION: Crowds fill the avenues of Ciidesh as a mass uprising topples the throne of Stratocracy of Ciidesh! The ancient autocracy is abolished, and Soishaepii proclaims the sovereign United Provinces of Ciidesh!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Shadow agents from Kobjiybob divert 25 gold from the tax vaults of Kolstan!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Shadow agents from Kuzrez divert 25 gold from the tax vaults of Tlewtek!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Meru are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Korunahu!
HUNT IN PROGRESS: Lopu duels Brimstone the Dragon-King! The titan endures with 2/340 HP.
QUEST COMPLETED: Mending the Talking Drum Tower of Tabowomo! Iwa hears the drum speak across the city again, and elders bestow Immortal Renown and a steadier realm!

EXPEDITION TRIUMPH: Nkinba and the hosts of Nyunwa defeat Brimstone the Dragon-King, banishing the immortal titan into deep slumber in Wilds beyond Riabad! Spoils: Blood-Scale Saber (Ancient Dragon Blood & Pyre Scales), boosting stability (+20) and treasury (+150 gold).

A Hara and a Tlinchit wed openly in Meru, and the house of Mongontoy begins; some elders frown, more of them smile. Nikumu is of Tomb Revenant and Lizardfolk blood.
After long debate, Soadesh lays serfdom to rest and adopts free citizenry.
Too much power drawn from the holy seat of Reformed Covenant of Dowdal: the line ruptures in a pillar of light that burns across Gubhumi.

Ina of Sage comes to the throne bent on a lasting legacy.

The War of the Diashudesh Crown is known as the Usurpation in Riavarta, and as the Reclamation in Diashudesh.

Sewe of Sawo turns from the old cause toward knowledge.

Liishoa of Daapatna turns from the old cause toward vengeance.

In the bustling market squares of Mesopebe, the charismatic prophet Bite begins preaching miraculous visions, winning throngs of converts to the newly revealed Biteite Cult.

Seeking to restore imperial order by force, Principality of Ledadium dispatches punitive legions to subdue People's Republic of Finsop. The bitter Invasion of Finsop is underway.
Uchor (Philosopher) drafts a universal legal code that enhances provincial stability in Camulu.
Krisvishva (Archmage) unravels a supernatural anomaly in the mountains in Groyva.
COVERT INTRIGUE: Agitators dispatched by Kolstan stir mutiny among garrison troops in Tlatkit!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Clandestine agents from Kuhzoz sow suspicion in the frontier councils of Lihseshuacan Beyond.

The Caer Dag–Kil-gar Maglev of Cidium reaches Tortaf: a new station opens to cheering crowds (+trade).

The voice of Gozgey rings through the great markets of Zopkzohy, denouncing the arrogance of the wealthy and calling for justice and spiritual purity across Tiasheu.
Unrest of the year: bread riots in Wol'as (Ma'bay).

Envoys from Kofa and Vingetika exchange solemn vows of mutual defense, binding their courts in a grand alliance.

Vowuraka of Korunahu takes up the cause of a lasting legacy.

Iwa of Yuga takes up the cause of the fortunes of the dynasty.
A perilous interregnum grips Yuga following the heirless death of Ifa (a wasting sickness). Retainers of House Yiwawukabe storm the assembly and usurp the crown.

Kinnina is acclaimed ruler of United Provinces of Lahkoch.

Outraged by treason, the crown of Merchant League of Nyunwa mobilizes imperial cohorts to crush the upstart insurrection in United Provinces of Lahkoch. The Border War of Lahkoch begins in fire and iron.

REPUBLICAN REVOLT: Weary of monarchical tyranny, the burghers and civic guilds of Finsop take up arms for freedom! Seceding from Ledadium, they hoist republican banners beneath Lilntal to establish the Confederation of Finsop.
Lilntal is acclaimed ruler of Confederation of Finsop.
Seeking to restore imperial order by force, Principality of Ledadium dispatches punitive legions to subdue Confederation of Finsop. The bitter Finsop Campaign is underway.

Pokmir is acclaimed ruler of Stratocracy of Papbhumi.
Seeking to restore imperial order by force, Merchant League of Rirhamdek dispatches punitive legions to subdue Stratocracy of Papbhumi. The bitter Rirhamdek Succession War is underway.

Myomfo is acclaimed ruler of Workers' Federation of Ki-nyu.

Kizruka of Kuhzoz outlaws a league of the landless. The serfs fall silent, for now.

The final citadels fall, and the crown of People's Republic of Finsop is broken forever. With treasuries emptied and borders dissolved, Khakhgoz Zetships flees into bitter exile as the realm fades into legend.
Ballgame Festival: Warriors of Haypan parade and wrestle in the squares of Haypan to honour the old victories.
The Invasion of Finsop reaches its conclusion after 1 year of bloodshed: Ledadium & Vingetika triumph decisively, forcing a humiliating treaty upon their foes.

Old border feuds boil over into open bloodshed: Hueyitlatocayotl of Tlewtek launches a determined invasion into Merchant League of Yupshyaz, igniting the Yupshyaz Campaign. Pledging mutual defense, the levies of Nyunwa rally to Yupshyaz's side.
Kalmeltuma II of Choschek comes to the throne bent on glory.

Nula of Sakeninadu takes up the cause of the safety of the realm.

Banners trampled and throne abandoned, Confederation of Finsop ceases to exist as a sovereign power. Lilntal Zhalsheh flees the ashes of their former dominion.
Spring Festival: People of Diqoqia wake the year with song and fresh green boughs at Capu.
Festival of Colours: People of Daapatna wake the year with song and fresh green boughs at Daapatna.
A victor's peace is forged: after 1 year of campaign in the Finsop Campaign, Ledadium prevail, annexing contested borderlands.
An ancient sovereign power falls to dust: United Provinces of Lahkoch is extinguished. Royal archives smolder, and Kinnina Lennoysiynon flees into obscurity.
The Border War of Lahkoch reaches its conclusion after 1 year of bloodshed: Nyunwa triumph decisively, forcing a humiliating treaty upon their foes.
Rice Blessing: Granaries of Rirhamdek are opened at Lebngiy; the whole town eats until dusk.
First Fruit Offerings: Granaries of Luvokanui are opened at Ngame; the whole town eats until dusk.
The walls of Ki-nya crumble under heavy assault! Cohorts of Ngimyumzomlu breach the defenses of Ki-nya's capital, scattering the garrison and sacking the palace.
An ancient sovereign power falls to dust: United Provinces of Ki-nya is extinguished. Royal archives smolder, and Nkimzensa Ntintonromyo flees into obscurity.
The Ngimyumzomlu Succession War reaches its conclusion after less than a year of bloodshed: Ngimyumzomlu triumph decisively, forcing a humiliating treaty upon their foes.
Denouncing ancient covenants, the heralds of High Realm of Gubhumi proclaim war upon Dwarf-Hold of Sezhas. Trumpets sound across the frontier as the War of Gubhumi begins.
White banners flutter over the war camps. The War of Gubhumi ends in mutual exhaustion after less than a year; borders return to former lines.
Nwunzenpa of Ki-nyu takes up the cause of the safety of the realm.
Dynastic extinction strikes Ki-nyu: Myomfo dies heirless (old age). Amid whispers of poison and sword-drawn councils, House Ngonbempannu claims the vacant crown.
COUP D'ETAT: Armed regiments loyal to Reri storm the government palace in Kofa! The faction seizes control, establishing the High Realm of Kofa.

COUP D'ETAT: Mutinous conspirators led by Hivzhizla strike at midnight in Rezvazamin! The revolutionary council seizes control, overthrowing the sovereign and proclaiming the Principality of Rezvazamin!
COUP D'ETAT: Armed regiments loyal to Mwenyumpi storm the government palace in Ngimyumzomlu! The faction seizes control, establishing the Polytechnic League of Ngimyumzomlu.
COVERT INTRIGUE: Agitators dispatched by Chichtitlan stir mutiny among garrison troops in Rezvazamin!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Riavarta are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Haghkeloth!
QUEST UNDERTAKEN: Ntimre embarks upon the Rescue of the Flooded Granary at Ngimyemnunvi! Ntimre learns that river floods are creeping toward the stored grain at Ngimyemnunvi.
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Meabad pave the Meabad-Hitchop Maritime Lane, establishing a direct route between Meabad and Hitchop (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Megiland pave the Tabowomo-Yaddowpura Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Tabowomo and Yaddowpura (+trade, +stability).
NATURE BLESSING: Gorath the Stone Peak heaves rich subterranean veins to the surface of Sawo! Granite ramparts harden against all siegecraft (+25 gold, +15 stability).
Fear grips the outskirts of Momelafe as villagers uncover shrines belonging to the Disciples of the Void Star. The coven's clandestine activities provoke fervent investigations by the crown.
Clad in simple sackcloth, the reformer Rututo enters the gates of Tumahu, fearlessly rebuking the decadence of imperial courts and summoning magistrates to humility.
Unrest of the year: tax riots in Kiqyeh; tax riots in Abmeblich (Babseykab); sectarian clashes in Porta Reqi (Kofa).

Reri of Kofa comes to the throne bent on knowledge.
Hivzhizla of Rezvazamin comes to the throne bent on the safety of the realm.
Mwenyumpi of Ngimyumzomlu comes to the throne bent on wealth.
House Nginla of Lihseshuacan Beyond and House Myanwumrumvu of Nyunwa were joined in royal marriage.
Hexzuq'yx conquered Floor 1 (Floor of the Sunken Crypt) using assault (score 41 vs DC 8). Defeated Astra. Promoted to F-Rank!
Kuzhpakkha survived descent to Layer 1 (Edge of the Abyss), enduring 11 strain damage: Light dizziness and loss of balance upon ascent. Whistle tier: red. Salvaged ancient relic: Sun Stone Shard!
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Ngewati bars the shaft to Reugarh, and the tithe-collectors of Rousheu are turned back at the lamps of Tlatkit.
SKY BLOCKADE: the floating hosts of Durbek close the air-lanes above Ngengo, starving Nyunwa of the high trade.
Winds that bend palms to the ground hammer the coast of Nyunwa at summer’s end; Mwenyu is flooded to the market square.

monsters.name: The Great Calydonian Boar
monsters.lore: A massive armored tusker leading wild forest herds, tearing up farmland and trampling watchtowers.
monsters.trophy: Calydonian Boar Great Tusks & Armored Hide

monsters.name: The Deep Lake Wyrm
monsters.lore: An elusive plesiosaur-like lake cryptid spoken of in local campfire folklore, surfacing only when mists veil the waters.

monsters.name: Behemoth the Earth-Shaker
monsters.lore: A colossal terrestrial colossus whose bones are tubes of bronze and limbs like bars of iron, roaming ancient grasslands.

monsters.name: The Celestial Raptor
monsters.lore: A colossal winged terror of celestial heights whose wingspan eclipses the noon sun and commands cyclones.

monsters.name: Brimstone the Dragon-King
monsters.lore: An ancient volcanic dragon sleeping atop mountains of melted gold, reducing invading armies to calcined bones.

monsters.name: The Emerald Qilin
monsters.lore: A gentle horned dragon-beast cloaked in scales of jade, appearing only during the reigns of benevolent and enlightened rulers.

monsters.name: The Dune-Shadow Roc
monsters.lore: The roc of sailors' and caravaneers' tall tales, a bird vast enough to carry off an elephant; its wingbeats raise dust storms over the canyons.

monsters.name: The Great Sun Lion
monsters.lore: An immortal noble lion with a mane of radiant sunlight, whose majestic roar dispels dark enchantments.
monsters.trophy: Solar Lion Mane of Golden Light

monsters.name: The Ahuizotl of the Lake
monsters.lore: A water dog with a hand at the end of its tail that drags fishermen beneath the lake.

monsters.name: The River-Blocker
monsters.lore: A huge river creature of the deep forest that blocks the flow of rivers with its body.

monsters.name: The Timingila of the Deep
monsters.lore: A sea monster of the old epics so vast it swallows whales whole, and is itself swallowed by something larger still.

monsters.name: The Each-uisge of the Loch
monsters.lore: A water horse that lets riders mount, then plunges into the loch with them stuck fast.

monsters.name: the Spellscar Wyrm
monsters.lore: A serpent of raw magic born where a leyline tore open.
monsters.lair: the scar at the holy seat of Feathered Serpent of the Tlinchit

monsters.name: the Walking Rift
monsters.lore: Wild magic given a body, it wanders the land the surge burned.
monsters.lair: the scar at the holy seat of Mana of Tongera

monsters.name: the Pale Surge
monsters.lore: A hungry ghost of spent magic that drains the living.
monsters.lair: the scar at The Lyceum of Reason

species.name: Human
species.desc: Versatile and ambitious mortals who build sprawling empires across every continent.

species.name: Elf
species.desc: Graceful, long-lived beings attuned to primal magic, ancient forests, and stellar harmonies.

species.name: Dwarf
species.desc: Stout, resolute masters of masonry, deep mining, and forged steel who carve citadels into living stone.

species.name: Orc
species.desc: Fierce, muscular warriors governed by martial honor, blood covenants, and relentless resilience.

species.name: Troll
species.desc: Massive, regenerative brutes of mossy crags and deep wetlands possessing primeval strength.

species.name: Beastman
species.desc: Prideful therianthropic folk bearing lupine, feline, or minotaur aspects, hunters of boundless wildlands.

species.name: Halfling
species.desc: Clever, jovial, and nimble folk who build peaceful pastoral burrows or intricate clockwork workshops.

species.name: Giant
species.desc: Colossal beings of primeval stone, frost, and storm, keeping ancient memory of the world's dawn.

species.name: Goblin
species.desc: Prolific, cunning, and resourceful tinkerers who thrive in shadowy crevices, mines, and scrap cities.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.desc: Scale-bound noble warriors descended from dragons, wielding elemental breath and stubborn pride.

species.name: Merfolk
species.desc: Aquatic humanoids of the coral reefs and sunlit shallows, rulers of the pelagic depths.

species.name: Starborn
species.desc: Luminous beings born of falling stars and astral conduits, radiating transcendent grace.

species.name: Ratfolk
species.desc: Cunning subterranean rodentkin and warpstone tinkerers who breed rapidly in foul under-empires.

species.name: Lizardfolk
species.desc: Cold-blooded ancient guardians of the geomantic web who defend temple-cities under primal mandates.

species.name: Tomb Revenant
species.desc: Ancient slumbering skeletal pharaohs and living-metal monarchs commanding eternal legions.

species.name: Ogor
species.desc: Massive nomadic brute warriors driven by eternal hunger and gut-magic across mountains and steppes.

species.name: Void Elf
species.desc: Ancient psychic wanderers of cosmic webways with spirit stones preserving souls against the void.

species.name: Warp Fiend
species.desc: Horned warp-manifestations born of cosmic fractures and excess emotion hungry for slaughter.

species.name: Chitin Swarm
species.desc: Synaptic bio-constructs with chittering carapaces driven by a devouring hive-mind.

diseases.name: plague
diseases.desc: carried by fleas on rats and on the cloth of traders; it rides the roads and the ships

diseases.name: flux
diseases.desc: drunk from fouled wells and river water; it follows the rivers downstream and haunts the ports

diseases.name: pox
diseases.desc: passed hand to hand and breath to breath; those who live through it never take it again

diseases.name: marsh fever
symptoms: a yellow cast to the skin
diseases.desc: brought by biting flies in hot wetlands; it lingers where the water stands still

diseases.name: consumption
symptoms: a cough that brings up blood
diseases.desc: a slow sickness of crowded cities that eats the lungs over years

diseases.name: blight
diseases.desc: a rot of the crops, not of people: it kills by hunger

diseases.name: miasma
symptoms: a lead taste in the mouth
diseases.desc: the bad air of the factory towns, thickest where the chimneys stand closest

diseases.name: radiation sickness
diseases.desc: not caught but soaked up: it clings to fallout grounds and the dust of old craters

diseases.name: engineered strain
diseases.desc: something made in a vat or a lab that got out; it spreads fast and burns out fast

diseases.name: hollowing
symptoms: a cold that no fire warms
diseases.desc: a sickness of the spirit; the old wives say it comes from broken wards

Night of Wreaths: Bonfires on the hills of ZosuRus greet the high sun above Choshufi.
Exhausted by protracted attrition, both sides sign an armistice concluding the Bytsahugorod Campaign (2 years). Scabbards are sheathed and the status quo ante is restored.
Yahpipan overruns the defensive holdfasts of Cardac, annexing the town and its fertile environs from Dadnikvarta.
Flames engulf the towers of Tesshapur! Soldiers of Yahpipan force the inner courtyards of Dadnikvarta's capital; the royal garrison breaks, and the seat of power falls.
Feast of the Pilgrim Caravan: Granaries of Bilad Lila are opened at Lilar; the whole town eats until dusk.
Festival of the Ancestors: Families in Tofefuland set out lamps and food for their dead at Depabo.
Sparks from a smithy ignite a fierce firestorm in Wanbonwang, destroying ancient temples and market pavilions.
Hodu (Master Artisan) unveils a breathtaking marble colossus in the central plaza in Vyvizipy.
COUP D'ETAT: Armed regiments loyal to Medkhuha storm the government palace in Boyvek! The faction seizes control, establishing the Patriarchate of Boyvek.

POPULAR REVOLUTION: Rising against tyranny and privilege, the populace of Qashu storms the seat of government! With the former regime swept aside, Baka proclaims the foundation of the Confederation of Qashu!
COUP D'ETAT: Mutinous conspirators led by Ramdih strike at midnight in Dadney! The revolutionary council seizes control, overthrowing the sovereign and proclaiming the Grand Marshalate of Dadney!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Assassins from Bilad Sira strike in the dead of night, slaying Wube in the court of Pegona!
QUEST COMPLETED: Recovery of the Buried Bells of Ngengoloho! Shuga raises the bells and rings them in the square, earning the sacred relic Hallowed Amulet of Sonesa!
QUEST UNDERTAKEN: Webe embarks upon the Raid on the Shadow Keep in Wusu! Webe gathers scouts and infiltrates the frontier redoubts near Wusu to pinpoint the captive's cell.
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Pegona pave the Mupe-Ightyylek Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Mupe and Ightyylek (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of AthR' pave the AthR'-Memi Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between AthR' and Memi (+trade, +stability).
The Debre Limmik–Muwloz Maglev of Womnoqia reaches Qelquk: a new station opens to cheering crowds (+trade).
A charismatic ascetic, Nehshathuh, captivates the plazas of Rigwich. Preaching equality before heaven, the prophet inspires a massive moral revival among the common folk.

Medkhuha of Boyvek comes to the throne bent on glory.
Baka of Qashu comes to the throne bent on the spread of the faith.
Ramdih of Dadney comes to the throne bent on the fortunes of the dynasty.
Liqu conquered Floor 1 (Floor of the Iron Plains) using magic (score 38 vs DC 8). Defeated Sylas. Promoted to F-Rank!
Shuga survived descent to Layer 1 (Edge of the Abyss), enduring 8 strain damage: Light dizziness and loss of balance upon ascent. Whistle tier: red.
Yahpipan crushes a league of the low-born; its leaders hang and the lay castes are bound tighter.
In Rufuhiza, a call to break the lords' hold takes root among the serfs, demanding an end to serfdom.
A league of the landless spreads through the towns of Zachyvu; pamphlets and sermons decry manorial fiefs.
The overdrawn leyline at the holy seat of Tangaroa of the Witatitu surges: wild magic scours the land of Lihseshuacan and the mages are struck down.
A royal wedding joins Gozhupi of Fobyska and Fisho of Shige; the two realms are united under one crown.
Lavu squeezes the shaft-tolls of Butstan; the miners of Fengaphoy mutter beneath the stone.
Nirvoh squeezes the shaft-tolls of Wanbonwang; the miners of Hurkota Beyond mutter beneath the stone.
Fengaphoy squeezes the shaft-tolls of Tangbun; the miners of Tangbun mutter beneath the stone.
Bilad Sira squeezes the shaft-tolls of Samzhenkey; the miners of Keymuf mutter beneath the stone.
A whirlwind walks across the plains of Yahpipan at midsummer and through the heart of Divigi, scattering roofs like leaves.
The swarm comes from the dry lands in high summer: every green thing around Vyvidafi is eaten, and the granaries of Tisiru cannot fill.

monsters.name: Lion of the Golden Dawn
monsters.lore: An immortal noble lion with a mane of radiant sunlight, whose majestic roar dispels dark enchantments.
monsters.trophy: Solar Lion Mane of Golden Light

monsters.name: The Thousand-Tentacled Horror
monsters.lore: A colossal multi-tentacled sea monster capable of pulling entire armadas down into the black abyss.

monsters.name: Brimstone the Dragon-King
monsters.lore: An ancient volcanic dragon sleeping atop mountains of melted gold, reducing invading armies to calcined bones.

monsters.name: The Great Calydonian Boar
monsters.lore: A massive armored tusker leading wild forest herds, tearing up farmland and trampling watchtowers.
monsters.trophy: Calydonian Boar Great Tusks & Armored Hide

monsters.name: Nessie the Mist-Lurker
monsters.lore: An elusive plesiosaur-like lake cryptid spoken of in local campfire folklore, surfacing only when mists veil the waters.

monsters.name: The Primeval Behemoth
monsters.lore: A colossal terrestrial colossus whose bones are tubes of bronze and limbs like bars of iron, roaming ancient grasslands.

monsters.name: The Celestial Raptor
monsters.lore: A colossal winged terror of celestial heights whose wingspan eclipses the noon sun and commands cyclones.

monsters.name: The Emerald Qilin
monsters.lore: A gentle horned dragon-beast cloaked in scales of jade, appearing only during the reigns of benevolent and enlightened rulers.

monsters.name: Draugr of the Howe
monsters.lore: An undead warrior who guards the treasure of its burial mound, growing heavier than an ox.

monsters.name: The Ponaturi of the Reef
monsters.lore: Hostile sea goblins of the old hero tales who sleep beneath the waves by day and come ashore at night; sunlight destroys them.

monsters.name: Timingila the Whale-Swallower
monsters.lore: A sea monster of the old epics so vast it swallows whales whole, and is itself swallowed by something larger still.

monsters.name: Hand-Tailed Ahuizotl
monsters.lore: A water dog with a hand at the end of its tail that drags fishermen beneath the lake.

monsters.name: the Burning Line
monsters.lore: A serpent of raw magic born where a leyline tore open.
monsters.lair: the scar at the holy seat of Flame of Dofshesh

monsters.name: the Coil of Light
monsters.lore: A serpent of raw magic born where a leyline tore open.
monsters.lair: the scar at the holy seat of Ifá of Wedoteno

monsters.name: the Shard Colossus

species.name: Human
species.desc: Versatile and ambitious mortals who build sprawling empires across every continent.

species.name: Elf
species.desc: Graceful, long-lived beings attuned to primal magic, ancient forests, and stellar harmonies.

species.name: Dwarf
species.desc: Stout, resolute masters of masonry, deep mining, and forged steel who carve citadels into living stone.

species.name: Orc
species.desc: Fierce, muscular warriors governed by martial honor, blood covenants, and relentless resilience.

species.name: Troll
species.desc: Massive, regenerative brutes of mossy crags and deep wetlands possessing primeval strength.

species.name: Beastman
species.desc: Prideful therianthropic folk bearing lupine, feline, or minotaur aspects, hunters of boundless wildlands.

species.name: Halfling
species.desc: Clever, jovial, and nimble folk who build peaceful pastoral burrows or intricate clockwork workshops.

species.name: Giant
species.desc: Colossal beings of primeval stone, frost, and storm, keeping ancient memory of the world's dawn.

species.name: Goblin
species.desc: Prolific, cunning, and resourceful tinkerers who thrive in shadowy crevices, mines, and scrap cities.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.desc: Scale-bound noble warriors descended from dragons, wielding elemental breath and stubborn pride.

species.name: Merfolk
species.desc: Aquatic humanoids of the coral reefs and sunlit shallows, rulers of the pelagic depths.

species.name: Starborn
species.desc: Luminous beings born of falling stars and astral conduits, radiating transcendent grace.

species.name: Ratfolk
species.desc: Cunning subterranean rodentkin and warpstone tinkerers who breed rapidly in foul under-empires.

species.name: Lizardfolk
species.desc: Cold-blooded ancient guardians of the geomantic web who defend temple-cities under primal mandates.

species.name: Tomb Revenant
species.desc: Ancient slumbering skeletal pharaohs and living-metal monarchs commanding eternal legions.

species.name: Ogor
species.desc: Massive nomadic brute warriors driven by eternal hunger and gut-magic across mountains and steppes.

species.name: Void Elf
species.desc: Ancient psychic wanderers of cosmic webways with spirit stones preserving souls against the void.

species.name: Warp Fiend
species.desc: Horned warp-manifestations born of cosmic fractures and excess emotion hungry for slaughter.

species.name: Chitin Swarm
species.desc: Synaptic bio-constructs with chittering carapaces driven by a devouring hive-mind.

diseases.name: plague
diseases.desc: carried by fleas on rats and on the cloth of traders; it rides the roads and the ships

diseases.name: flux
diseases.desc: drunk from fouled wells and river water; it follows the rivers downstream and haunts the ports

diseases.name: pox
diseases.desc: passed hand to hand and breath to breath; those who live through it never take it again

diseases.name: marsh fever
symptoms: a yellow cast to the skin
diseases.desc: brought by biting flies in hot wetlands; it lingers where the water stands still

diseases.name: consumption
symptoms: a cough that brings up blood
diseases.desc: a slow sickness of crowded cities that eats the lungs over years

diseases.name: blight
diseases.desc: a rot of the crops, not of people: it kills by hunger

diseases.name: miasma
symptoms: a lead taste in the mouth
diseases.desc: the bad air of the factory towns, thickest where the chimneys stand closest

diseases.name: radiation sickness
diseases.desc: not caught but soaked up: it clings to fallout grounds and the dust of old craters

diseases.name: engineered strain
diseases.desc: something made in a vat or a lab that got out; it spreads fast and burns out fast

diseases.name: hollowing
symptoms: a cold that no fire warms
diseases.desc: a sickness of the spirit; the old wives say it comes from broken wards
